about.title: About Us
about.body: ISL - the F1 Israeli Super League - is one of Israel's premier F1 sim racing leagues, formed by the merger of two established communities, PSGiL and F1IL, into a single grid. We race on the EA Sports F1 series at 50% distance with no driving assists - full driver control, real strategy, and results that are earned. ISL is built by drivers, for drivers: competitive grids, a supportive community, and a firm commitment to clean, respectful racing on and off the track. With two structured seasons a year, consistent stewarding, and full Drivers and Teams standings, ISL brings the experience of both leagues together to set a high standard for organized sim racing in Israel.
